observed_missing.specific_defect: L-SSC-131-R11 stores R_v^(uw) as an opaque raw source term in its fourth equality. Neither the L131 G1 0.2 occurrence list nor its G2 expression graph separately exposes the direct source definition R_v^(uw)=R_v^w R_v^u. The R12 even-word factorization refers to rotations without supplying this exact operator-level definition.
observed_missing.why_material: A verifier could claim reconstruction by comparing the four recorded names while leaving the right-side rotation uninterpreted. Equality of three-role permutations does not establish equality of typed coefficient transformations.
observed_missing.distinguish: R_p^(uw) occurs in the displayed four-part chain, but its direct identification with the two p-reflections must be established from exact source/typed operations; do not invent a separate source equation without labeling derivation.
